message.content:
Here are the best sources for free 3D game assets in 2026, organized by category:

## Top Free 3D Asset Websites

### **Kenney.nl** — Best All-Rounder
- **40,000+ assets** in a consistent low-poly style
- **License:** CC0 (Public Domain) — no attribution required, commercial use allowed
- Includes 2D sprites, 3D models, UI elements, fonts, and audio
- Perfect for rapid prototyping and game jams

### **Quaternius** — Best for Stylized 3D Games
- Thousands of modular, themed collections (fantasy, sci-fi, nature)
- **License:** CC0
- Assets come **rigged and animated**, ready for Unity, Unreal, or Godot
- Signature clean, bright, charming low-poly aesthetic

### **Poly Haven** — Best for Realistic Assets & PBR
- **License:** CC0
- PBR textures, HDRIs, and 3D models
- Realistic props and environmental pieces
- No sign-up required

### **Sketchfab** — Best for Variety & Preview
- **500,000+ free models** with interactive 3D preview before download
- Various licenses (many CC0 or CC-BY — check each asset)
- Supports GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ formats

### **TurboSquid Free Section** — Best Professional-Grade Assets
- High polygon count, detailed textures
- Royalty-free licenses (check specific terms)
- Suitable for AAA-style projects

### **PolyScann** — Best for Unity-Ready Assets
- All models are **CC0**, game-ready with PBR textures
- Compatible with Unity's Built-in, URP, and HDRP render pipelines
- Categories include buildings, medieval props, industrial assets

### **Mixamo** — Best for Characters & Animations
- **Free with Adobe account**
- Auto-rigging service and motion-captured animation library
- Covers walks, runs, combat, idles, and more
- Free for commercial use, no royalties or attribution

## Free Textures & Materials

| Website | Specialty | License |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| **ambientCG** | 2,000+ PBR materials up to 8K/16K | CC0 |
| **CGBookcase** | High-quality PBR textures with tutorials | CC0 |
| **Textures.com** (free tier) | 15 free credits/day for high-res textures | Mixed |

## Free Audio

| Website | Specialty | License |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| **Freesound** | 600,000+ sound effects | Creative Commons (filter for CC0) |
| **Sonniss GDC Bundles** | Professional game audio archives | Royalty-free, no attribution |
| **OpenGameArt** | Music, SFX, 2D/3D assets | Mixed open licenses |

## AI-Powered Free/Tiered Options (2026)

| Tool | What It Does | Free Tier |
|------|--------------|-----------|
| **Meshy.ai** | Text-to-3D and Image-to-3D | Available |
| **Luma Genie** | 3D generation with clean topology | Available |
| **Scenario.gg** | AI asset generation with custom model training | Free trial |

## Important Tips

1. **Always check the license** before commercial use — CC0 is safest, CC-BY requires attribution
2. **Stick to 1-2 visual styles** per project for consistency
3. **Recommended formats:** GLB/glTF for web games (all-in-one, 60% faster integration); FBX for Unity/Unreal
4. **Polygon budgets:** Mobile 5K-20K, Web 10K-50K, PC/Console 50K-300K triangles
